Thanks for the demo last week — Ausway is excited to move forward. We want to align on a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can track milestones on both sides and hit a July 15 launch target for the first integration phase (search + summarization). High level asks from our side:

- Finalize integration requirements and API keys (Ausway engineering)

Hi all — adding the implementation milestones and who will own them on Redwood's side. See condensed milestones below (full checkpoint table in the attached spreadsheet):

Milestone / Target / Owner / Acceptance
- Kickoff meeting / 12-May / Rachel / Meeting notes and action items captured
- Sandbox access provisioned / 24-May / Eng oncall (cc'd after kickoff) / API keys + sample dataset accessible
- Integration sprint 1 (auth + basic calls) / 31-May / Marissa / End-to-end sample requests succeed in sandbox
- Performance tuning & batching config / 18-Jun / Marissa / Latency p95 <= 600ms for 512 tokens in test harness
- Security/compliance review / 25-Jun / Markus / Completed questionnaire + access logs confirmed
- Go/No-Go review / 06-Jul / Exec sponsors / Formal signoff email
- Soft launch / 15-Jul / Customer ops / Monitor errors <1% and token cost aligned to forecast

Notes / asks for Ausway before sandbox:
- Provide a representative 2-3MB dataset and service account for testing
- Confirm required retention window and compliance requirements (PII handling)

I'll keep milestone owners updated each Tuesday in a short status note.
